scenes.stage_direction: Calls and protected interviews interrupt the search. Amara asks practical questions about Ethan's care before she asks about blame.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: She named Victor. She saw him carry Ethan down the service stair.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I don't feel better hearing someone believe me. I need him back.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: She is also naming the person who supplied the instruction.

metadata.evidence_summary: Lami confirms Victor carried Ethan from the service stair.
